Shelter, WASH & Protection

Water, Sanitation & Hygiene (WASH) Programme

Clean water, safe toilets and hygiene, built to keep working.

Planned

What it does

Access to clean water, safe toilets, handwashing facilities and hygiene education, delivered with specialist technical partners.

We budget for keeping facilities working — operations and maintenance — not only for installing them.

Who it is for

Camps, resettlement sites and host communities where water and sanitation are inadequate.

What success looks like

Facilities still functioning a year on, and fewer preventable illnesses in the community.

Where it operates

Planned for camps, resettlement sites and host communities within our existing footprint.

How it is delivered

Technical work delivered with specialist WASH partners. Partner to be confirmed at launch.

Status

Planned

Approved in our plan and scheduled, but not yet started. We say so plainly rather than implying it is already running.

Support this programme

Support the launch of this programme.

Donate

You can direct your gift to this programme, to a pillar, or to wherever it is most needed.

Delivery partners

No delivery partner is named for this programme yet. Where technical delivery is required we say who our partner is — and where we have not yet appointed one, we say that too.
